name: The Watch
premise: Your believers are points of light and the dark presses in from every side.
loop: You hold a shadow-shield over one cluster at a time while the dark gnaws at every unshielded light. Coverage is the shield's own shadow; the pressure visibly shifts, and you drag your protection between clusters knowing the rest are burning down.
signals: A shielded cluster sits in your cast shadow and burns steady; an unshielded cluster gutters, dims, and greys — the flame height itself is the state.
outcome_win: Dawn arrives with the clusters you chose still burning.
outcome_fail: The lights you abandoned are grey by morning, standing exactly where you left them.
why_fun: Triage under guaranteed loss — the skill is deciding what to lose, and living with it.
pattern_source: Triage — protect what you can; Diegetic state display
gdd_quote: You shield what you can and you cannot shield everything
